questions.text: अमन, बोमन तथा चेतन एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा 5:3:2 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटते थे । दिनेश को एक नया साझेदार बनाया गया। उसने अपने संपूर्ण भाग का अधिग्रहण अमन से किया । अमन ने लाभ के अपने भाग का $\frac{1}{5}$ त्याग दिनेश के पक्ष में किया। निम्नलिखित में से फर्म के लाभों में किस भाग के लिए दिनेश को प्रवेश दिया गया ?
questions.text_english: Aman, Boman and Chetan were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 5:3:2. Dinesh was admitted as a new partner who acquired his share entirely from Aman. Aman surrendered $\frac{1}{5}^{th}$ of his share in the profits to Dinesh. Dinesh was admitted for which of the following share in the profits of the firm ?
questions.solution: Aman's original share in the firm is 5/10. He surrenders 1/5th of his share in favour of Dinesh. Therefore, the sacrifice made by Aman = 1/5 of 5/10 = 1/10. Since Dinesh acquires his share entirely from Aman, Dinesh's share in the profits of the firm will be equal to Aman's sacrifice, which is 1/10. Hence, the correct option is (A).
questions.solution_hindi: अमन का पुराना भाग 5/10 है। वह अपने भाग का 1/5 भाग दिनेश के पक्ष में त्याग करता है। इसलिए, अमन द्वारा किया गया त्याग = 5/10 का 1/5 = 1/10. चूँकि दिनेश अपना पूरा भाग अमन से प्राप्त करता है, अतः दिनेश का भाग अमन के त्याग के बराबर अर्थात् 1/10 होगा। अतः सही विकल्प (A) है।

questions.text: इमली, फरीदा तथा गौरी एक फर्म की साझेदार थीं तथा 4:3:1 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटती थीं । फरीदा को फर्म के लाभों में उसके भाग के लिए ₹ 35,000 की गारंटी दी गयी थी। इसके कारण हुई किसी भी कमी को इमली द्वारा वहन किया जाना था। 31 मार्च, 2024 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष में फर्म ने ₹ 80,000 का लाभ कमाया । फरीदा के पूँजी खाते में क्रेडिट किया गया लाभ था :
questions.text_english: Emily, Farida and Gauri were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 4:3:1. Farida was guaranteed ₹ 35,000 as her share in the profits in the firm. Any deficiency arising on that account was to be met by Emily. The firm earned a profit of ₹ 80,000 for the year ended 31st March 2024. The profit credited to Farida's capital account was:
questions.solution: Farida's actual share in the firm's profit of ₹ 80,000 is calculated as ₹ 80,000 × (3/8) = ₹ 30,000. Since this actual share (₹ 30,000) is less than her guaranteed minimum profit (₹ 35,000), there is a deficiency of ₹ 5,000. This deficiency is met by Emily. Thus, Farida will be credited with her guaranteed minimum amount of ₹ 35,000. Therefore, the correct option is (B).
questions.solution_hindi: फर्म के ₹ 80,000 के लाभ में फरीदा का वास्तविक भाग = ₹ 80,000 × (3/8) = ₹ 30,000 है। चूँकि यह वास्तविक भाग उसकी गारंटीकृत राशि (₹ 35,000) से कम है, इसलिए ₹ 5,000 की कमी उत्पन्न होती है जिसे इमली द्वारा वहन किया जाएगा। अतः फरीदा के खाते में उसकी गारंटीकृत राशि ₹ 35,000 क्रेडिट की जाएगी। सही विकल्प (B) है।

questions.text: अजय लिमिटेड ने ₹ 10 प्रत्येक के 100 अंशों का हरण, ₹ 1 प्रति अंश की प्रथम याचना तथा ₹ 3 प्रति अंश की दूसरी तथा अन्तिम याचना का भुगतान न करने पर कर लिया। प्रति अंश न्यूनतम मूल्य जिस पर इन अंशों का पुनः निर्गमन किया जा सकता है, होगा :
questions.text_english: Ajay Ltd. forfeited 100 shares of ₹ 10 each for non-payment of first call of ₹ 1 per share and second and final call of ₹ 3 per share. The minimum price per share at which these shares can be reissued will be :
questions.solution: A company can reissue forfeited shares at a discount, but the maximum discount allowed per share is equal to the amount already received on that share before forfeiture. The unpaid amount per share is ₹ 1 (first call) + ₹ 3 (second call) = ₹ 4. Since the face value is ₹ 10, the amount already paid (and hence forfeited) is ₹ 10 - ₹ 4 = ₹ 6 per share. The maximum discount allowed on reissue is ₹ 6 per share. Therefore, the minimum reissue price = Face Value - Maximum Discount = ₹ 10 - ₹ 6 = ₹ 4. The correct option is (B).
questions.solution_hindi: एक कंपनी हरण किए गए अंशों को बट्टे (discount) पर फिर से जारी कर सकती है, लेकिन अधिकतम बट्टा वह राशि है जो पहले ही प्राप्त हो चुकी है। प्रति अंश न चुकाई गई राशि = ₹ 1 + ₹ 3 = ₹ 4 है। अतः पहले ही प्राप्त (और हरण की गई) राशि = ₹ 10 - ₹ 4 = ₹ 6 प्रति अंश। पुनः निर्गमन पर दिया जा सकने वाला अधिकतम बट्टा ₹ 6 है। इसलिए, न्यूनतम निर्गमन मूल्य = ₹ 10 - ₹ 6 = ₹ 4 होगा। सही विकल्प (B) है।

questions.text: एक कम्पनी द्वारा चयनित लोगों के समूह को प्रतिभूतियों के अभिदान का प्रस्ताव या निमन्त्रण (जनता को प्रस्ताव के तरीके के अतिरिक्त) जाना जाता है :
questions.text_english: Offer of securities or invitation to subscribe securities to a select group of persons by a company (other than by way of public offer) is known as:
questions.solution: When a company offers its securities or invites a select, predetermined group of investors to subscribe to its securities, rather than making a general public offer, it is legally defined as the 'Private placement of shares'. Therefore, the correct option is (C).
questions.solution_hindi: जब एक कंपनी जनता के बजाय पूर्व-चयनित निवेशकों के एक छोटे समूह को अपने शेयर या प्रतिभूतियां जारी करती है, तो इसे 'अंशों का निजी आबंटन' (Private placement of shares) कहा जाता है। सही विकल्प (C) है।

questions.text: सुहास तथा विलास एक फर्म के साझेदार थे और उनकी पूँजी क्रमशः ₹ 4,00,000 तथा ₹ 3,00,000 थी। उन्होंने भविष्य के लाभों में 1/5 भाग के लिए प्रभास को एक नया साझेदार बनाया । प्रभास अपनी पूँजी के रूप में ₹ 2,00,000 लाया। ख्याति में प्रभास का भाग होगा :
questions.text_english: Suhas and Vilas were partners in a firm with capitals of ₹ 4,00,000 and ₹ 3,00,000 respectively. They admitted Prabhas as a new partner for 1/5th share in future profits. Prabhas brought ₹ 2,00,000 as his capital. Prabhas' share of goodwill will be :
questions.solution: This is a case of hidden goodwill. The total capitalized value of the new firm based on Prabhas's capital and his share is ₹ 2,00,000 × (5/1) = ₹ 10,00,000. The actual combined capital of all partners is Suhas's capital + Vilas's capital + Prabhas's capital = ₹ 4,00,000 + ₹ 3,00,000 + ₹ 2,00,000 = ₹ 9,00,000. The Hidden Goodwill of the entire firm = Capitalized value - Actual combined capital = ₹ 10,00,000 - ₹ 9,00,000 = ₹ 1,00,000. Prabhas's share of goodwill = Firm's goodwill × His share = ₹ 1,00,000 × (1/5) = ₹ 20,000. Therefore, the correct option is (D).

questions.text: राधिका, मेहर तथा शुभा एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा 9:8:7 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटते थे । यदि वर्ष के अन्त में लाभ में राधिका के भाग की राशि ₹ 5,40,000 थी तो शुभा के लाभ की राशि होगी :
questions.text_english: Radhika, Mehar and Shubha were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 9:8:7. If Radhika's share of profit at the end of the year amounted to ₹ 5,40,000, Shubha's share of profit will be:
questions.solution: The profit-sharing ratio is Radhika : Mehar : Shubha = 9 : 8 : 7. Radhika's share corresponds to 9 parts out of the total. Given that 9 parts = ₹ 5,40,000, the value of 1 part = ₹ 5,40,000 / 9 = ₹ 60,000. Shubha's share corresponds to 7 parts. Therefore, Shubha's profit = 7 × ₹ 60,000 = ₹ 4,20,000. The correct option is (D).

questions.text: वायने, शान तथा ब्रयान एक फर्म के साझेदार थे। शान ने फर्म को ₹ 1,00,000 का एक ऋण दिया हुआ था । 31 मार्च, 2024 को फर्म का विघटन हो गया। विभिन्न परिसम्पत्तियों (नगद तथा बैंक में नगद को छोड़कर) तथा बाह्य देयताओं को वसूली खाते में हस्तांतरित करने के पश्चात् शान ने ₹ 90,000 पुस्तक मूल्य का फर्नीचर अपने ऋण के आंशिक निपटान हेतु ले लिया। शान के ऋण खाते की शेष राशि के भुगतान के लिए बैंक खाते को क्रेडिट किया जायेगा :
questions.text_english: Wayne, Shaan and Bryan were partners in a firm. Shaan had advanced a loan of ₹ 1,00,000 to the firm. On 31st March, 2024 the firm was dissolved. After transferring various assets (other than cash & bank) and outside liabilities to Realisation Account, Shaan took over furniture of book value of ₹ 90,000 in part settlement of his loan amount. For the payment of balance amount of Shaan's loan Bank Account will be credited with:
questions.solution: Shaan's total loan amount is ₹ 1,00,000. He takes over furniture worth ₹ 90,000 in part settlement of his loan. The remaining unpaid balance of the loan is ₹ 1,00,000 - ₹ 90,000 = ₹ 10,000. This balance will be paid to him in cash/bank, so the Bank Account will be credited with ₹ 10,000. Therefore, the correct option is (D).
questions.solution_hindi: शान के ऋण की कुल राशि ₹ 1,00,000 है। वह अपने ऋण के आंशिक निपटान में ₹ 90,000 का फर्नीचर लेता है। अतः ऋण की शेष देय राशि = ₹ 1,00,000 - ₹ 90,000 = ₹ 10,000 होगी। इस शेष राशि का भुगतान बैंक से किया जाएगा, इसलिए बैंक खाते को ₹ 10,000 से क्रेडिट किया जाएगा। सही विकल्प (D) है।

questions.text: नंदिता तथा प्रभा एक फर्म की साझेदार थीं। नंदिता ने वर्ष में व्यक्तिगत उपयोग के लिए ₹ 3,00,000 का आहरण किया । साझेदारी संलेख में आहरण पर 10% वार्षिक दर से ब्याज लगाने का प्रावधान है । 31 मार्च, 2024 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष के लिए नंदिता के आहरण पर ब्याज होगा :
questions.text_english: Nandita and Prabha were partners in a firm. Nandita withdrew ₹ 3,00,000 during the year for personal use. The partnership deed provides for charging interest on drawings @ 10% p.a. Interest on Nandita's drawings for the year ended 31st March, 2024 will be :
questions.solution: When total drawings are given for the year but the specific dates of withdrawals are not mentioned, interest on drawings is calculated for an average period of 6 months. Interest on Nandita's drawings = Total Drawings × Rate × (6/12) = ₹ 3,00,000 × (10/100) × (6/12) = ₹ 15,000. Therefore, the correct option is (D).
questions.solution_hindi: जब वर्ष के दौरान आहरण की कुल राशि दी गई हो और आहरण की तिथियां नहीं दी गई हों, तो ब्याज की गणना औसतन 6 महीने के लिए की जाती है। ब्याज = ₹ 3,00,000 × 10% × (6/12) = ₹ 15,000. अतः सही विकल्प (D) है।

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A): एक साझेदारी फर्म में साझेदारों की अधिकतम संख्या 50 होती है।
कारण (R) : कम्पनी अधिनियम 2013 के आधार पर केन्द्र सरकार एक फर्म के सदस्यों की अधिकतम संख्या निर्धारित करने के लिए अधिकृत होती है। केन्द्र सरकार ने एक फर्म के सदस्यों की अधिकतम संख्या 50 निर्धारित की है।
निम्न में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): The maximum number of partners in a partnership firm is 50.
Reason (R) : By virtue of the Companies Act 2013, the Central Government is empowered to prescribe maximum number of partners in a firm. The Central Government has prescribed the maximum number of partners in a firm to be 50.
Choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) का सही वर्णन है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, परन्तु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) का सही वर्णन नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों असत्य हैं।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are false.

questions.solution: The Assertion (A) correctly states that the maximum number of partners in a firm is currently 50. The Reason (R) correctly explains that Section 464 of the Companies Act, 2013 empowers the Central Government to prescribe this limit, and under Rule 10 of the Companies (Miscellaneous) Rules, 2014, the limit has been set to 50. Therefore, both Assertion and Reason are true, and the Reason correctly explains the Assertion. Option A is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: अभिकथन (A) सही है कि साझेदारी फर्म में अधिकतम 50 साझेदार हो सकते हैं। कारण (R) सही ढंग से बताता है कि कंपनी अधिनियम 2013 के तहत केंद्र सरकार यह संख्या निर्धारित करती है और उसने यह सीमा 50 तय की है। अतः अभिकथन और कारण दोनों सत्य हैं तथा कारण सही व्याख्या करता है।

questions.text: काजल तथा लौरा एक फर्म की साझेदार थीं तथा 5:3 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटती थीं। उन्होंने भविष्य के लाभ में 1/4 भाग के लिए मैडी को साझेदार बनाया। मैडी अपनी पूँजी के रूप में ₹ 8,00,000 तथा ख्याति प्रीमियम के अपने भाग के रूप में ₹ 4,00,000 लाया। काजल, लौरा तथा मैडी ने भविष्य में लाभों को 2:1:1 के अनुपात में बाँटने का निर्णय लिया। ख्याति, परिसम्पत्तियों तथा देयताओं के पुनर्मूल्यांकन आदि से संबंधित सभी समायोजनों के पश्चात् काजल की पूँजी ₹ 15,00,000 तथा लौरा की पूँजी ₹ 8,00,000 थी। यह निर्णय लिया गया कि मैडी की पूँजी को आधार मानकर साझेदारों की पूँजी उनके नये लाभ विभाजन अनुपात में होगी। समायोजन, आवश्यकतानुसार नगद लाकर अथवा आहरण के द्वारा किया गया। काजल द्वारा लायी गयी नगद राशि थी :
questions.text_english: Kajal and Laura were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 5:3. They admitted Maddy for 1/4th share in future profits. Maddy brought ₹ 8,00,000 as his capital and ₹ 4,00,000 as his share of premium for goodwill. Kajal, Laura and Maddy decided to share profits in future in the ratio of 2:1:1. After all adjustments in respect of goodwill, revaluation of assets and liabilities etc. Kajal's capital was ₹ 15,00,000 and Laura's capital was ₹ 8,00,000. It was agreed that partners' capitals should be in proportion to their new profit sharing ratio taking Maddy's capital as base. The adjustment was made by bringing in or withdrawing the necessary cash as the case may be. The cash brought in by Kajal was:
questions.solution: Maddy is admitted for a 1/4th share with a capital of ₹ 8,00,000. The total capital of the newly constituted firm based on Maddy's capital will be ₹ 8,00,000 × (4/1) = ₹ 32,00,000. According to the new profit-sharing ratio of 2:1:1, Kajal's required new capital will be ₹ 32,00,000 × (2/4) = ₹ 16,00,000. Kajal's existing adjusted capital is given as ₹ 15,00,000. Thus, Kajal must bring in cash equal to the deficit: ₹ 16,00,000 - ₹ 15,00,000 = ₹ 1,00,000. Therefore, the correct option is (A).

questions.text: पुलकित तथा रविंदर एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा 3:2 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटते थे । सिकंदर को 1/5 भाग के लिए एक नया साझेदार बनाया गया । पुलकित, रविंदर तथा सिकंदर ने भविष्य में लाभों को 2:2:1 के अनुपात में बाँटने का निर्णय लिया। सिकंदर ₹ 5,00,000 अपनी पूँजी के रूप में तथा ₹ 10,00,000 ख्याति प्रीमियम के अपने भाग के रूप में लाया। ख्याति प्रीमियम की वह राशि जो पुराने साझेदारों के पूँजी खाते में क्रेडिट की जायेगी, होगी :
questions.text_english: Pulkit and Ravinder were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3:2. Sikander was admitted as a new partner for 1/5th share in the profits of the firm. Pulkit, Ravinder and Sikander decided to share future profits in the ratio of 2:2:1. Sikander brought ₹ 5,00,000 as his capital and ₹ 10,00,000 as his share of premium for goodwill. The amount of premium for goodwill that will be credited to the old partners' capital accounts will be:

options_english.B: Pulkit's Capital Account ₹ 6,00,000 and Ravinder's Capital Account ₹ 4,00,000
options_english.C: Pulkit's Capital Account ₹ 5,00,000 and Ravinder's Capital Account ₹ 5,00,000

questions.solution: The premium for goodwill is distributed among the sacrificing partners in their sacrificing ratio. Old ratio of Pulkit and Ravinder is 3:2. New ratio of Pulkit, Ravinder, and Sikander is 2:2:1. Pulkit's sacrifice = 3/5 - 2/5 = 1/5. Ravinder's sacrifice = 2/5 - 2/5 = 0. Since only Pulkit sacrifices his share, the entire premium for goodwill of ₹ 10,00,000 brought by Sikander will be credited exclusively to Pulkit's Capital Account. Therefore, the correct option is (A).

sub_questions.text: अनीशा, दीपा तथा चारू एक फर्म की साझेदार थीं तथा 5:3:2 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटती थीं । 31 मार्च, 2024 को उन्होंने अपने लाभ-विभाजन अनुपात को 2:3:5 में बदलने का निर्णय किया । लाभ-विभाजन अनुपात में परिवर्तन के कारण प्रत्येक साझेदार का अधिलाभ अथवा त्याग होगा :
sub_questions.text_english: Anisha, Deepa and Charu were partners sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 5:3:2. On 31st March, 2024, they decided to change their profit-sharing ratio to 2:3:5. Each partner's gain or sacrifice due to change in profit-sharing ratio will be :

options.A: अनीशा का त्याग 3/10 ; चारू का अधिलाभ 3/10
options.B: अनीशा का अधिलाभ 3/10 ; चारू का त्याग 3/10
options.C: अनीशा का त्याग 3/10 ; दीपा का अधिलाभ 3/10
options.D: दीपा का अधिलाभ 3/10 ; चारू का त्याग 3/10

sub_questions.solution:
The formula to calculate sacrifice or gain is Old Share - New Share. A positive result indicates a sacrifice, while a negative result indicates a gain. 
Anisha: 5/10 - 2/10 = 3/10 (Sacrifice). 
Deepa: 3/10 - 3/10 = 0 (No change). 
Charu: 2/10 - 5/10 = -3/10 (Gain). 
Thus, Anisha sacrifices 3/10 and Charu gains 3/10. The correct option is (A).

sub_questions.text: प्रीत तथा सरल एक फर्म की साझेदार थीं तथा 3:2 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटती थीं । 31 मार्च, 2024 को उन्होंने अपने लाभ-विभाजन अनुपात को 1:1 में बदलने का निर्णय लिया । पुनर्गठन की तिथि को फर्म की ख्याति का मूल्यांकन ₹ 1,00,000 किया गया । लाभ-विभाजन अनुपात में परिवर्तन के कारण ख्याति के लेखांकन की रोजनामचा प्रविष्टि होगी :
sub_questions.text_english: Preet and Saral were partners sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3:2. On 31st March, 2024 they decided to change their profit sharing ratio to 1:1. On the date of reconstitution goodwill of the firm was valued at ₹ 1,00,000. The journal entry for treatment of goodwill on account of change in profit-sharing ratio will be :

options.A: Preet's Capital A/c Dr. 1,00,000 To Saral's Capital A/c 1,00,000
options.B: Saral's Capital A/c Dr. 1,00,000 To Preet's Capital A/c 1,00,000
options.C: Preet's Capital A/c Dr. 10,000 To Saral's Capital A/c 10,000
options.D: Saral's Capital A/c Dr. 10,000 To Preet's Capital A/c 10,000

options_english.A: Preet's Capital A/c Dr. 1,00,000 To Saral's Capital A/c 1,00,000
options_english.B: Saral's Capital A/c Dr. 1,00,000 To Preet's Capital A/c 1,00,000
options_english.C: Preet's Capital A/c Dr. 10,000 To Saral's Capital A/c 10,000
options_english.D: Saral's Capital A/c Dr. 10,000 To Preet's Capital A/c 10,000

sub_questions.solution:
First, we calculate the gain or sacrifice for each partner (Old Share - New Share). 
Preet: 3/5 - 1/2 = 1/10 (Sacrifice). 
Saral: 2/5 - 1/2 = -1/10 (Gain). 
The gaining partner (Saral) must compensate the sacrificing partner (Preet) for their proportional share of the firm's goodwill. 
Compensation amount = Total Goodwill × Share gained = ₹ 1,00,000 × (1/10) = ₹ 10,000. 
Therefore, Saral's Capital A/c is debited by ₹ 10,000 and Preet's Capital A/c is credited by ₹ 10,000. The correct option is (D).

questions.text: भावना तथा वेदिका एक फर्म की साझेदार थीं तथा 5: 4 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटती थीं । 1 अप्रैल, 2024 से उन्होंने भविष्य में लाभ व हानि को 4: 5 के अनुपात में बाँटने का निर्णय लिया। इस तिथि को उनका स्थिति विवरण लाभ-हानि खाते में ₹ 1,80,000 का नाम शेष तथा सामान्य संचय में ₹ 6,30,000 का शेष दर्शा रहा था। साझेदारों ने लाभ-हानि खाते के नाम शेष को अपलिखित करने तथा सामान्य संचय को विभाजित न करने का निर्णय किया । फर्म के पुनर्गठन पर उपरोक्त लेनदेनों के लिए आवश्यक रोजनामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए। अपना कार्य स्पष्टता से दर्शाइये ।
questions.text_english: Bhawana and Vedika were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 5: 4. From 1st April, 2024 they decided to share future profits and losses in the ratio of 4:5. On this date, their balance sheet showed a debit balance of 1,80,000 in Profit and Loss Account and a balance of ₹ 6,30,000 in General Reserve. Partners decided to write off debit balance in Profit and Loss Account but decided not to distribute the General Reserve. Pass necessary journal entries for the above transactions on the reconstitution of the firm. Show your workings clearly.

key_points: Write off P&L A/c debit balance (₹ 1,80,000) by debiting partners' capital accounts in old ratio (5:4). Bhawana Dr. ₹ 1,00,000, Vedika Dr. ₹ 80,000.
Calculate sacrifice and gain. Bhawana sacrifice = 1/9, Vedika gain = 1/9.
Adjust General Reserve without distributing it. Adjustment amount = ₹ 6,30,000 × 1/9 = ₹ 70,000.
Journal entry for General Reserve: Debit gaining partner (Vedika) ₹ 70,000 and credit sacrificing partner (Bhawana) ₹ 70,000.

questions.solution:
Working Notes:
The old ratio between Bhawana and Vedika is 5:4. The new ratio is 4:5.
Let's calculate the sacrifice or gain for each partner: Old Share - New Share.
Bhawana: 5/9 - 4/9 = 1/9 (Sacrifice)
Vedika: 4/9 - 5/9 = -1/9 (Gain)

The partners decided to write off the Profit and Loss Account debit balance (₹ 1,80,000). This accumulated loss is transferred to their capital accounts in the old ratio (5:4).
Bhawana's share of loss = ₹ 1,80,000 × 5/9 = ₹ 1,00,000.
Vedika's share of loss = ₹ 1,80,000 × 4/9 = ₹ 80,000.

Since the General Reserve (₹ 6,30,000) is not to be distributed, an adjustment entry must be passed through the capital accounts based on the sacrifice/gain ratio.
Amount of adjustment = ₹ 6,30,000 × 1/9 = ₹ 70,000.
The gaining partner (Vedika) will be debited, and the sacrificing partner (Bhawana) will be credited.

Journal Entries:
1. Bhawana's Capital A/c    Dr.  ₹ 1,00,000
   Vedika's Capital A/c     Dr.  ₹ 80,000
       To Profit and Loss A/c            ₹ 1,80,000
(Being the debit balance of P&L account written off in the old ratio 5:4)

2. Vedika's Capital A/c     Dr.  ₹ 70,000
       To Bhawana's Capital A/c          ₹ 70,000
(Being adjustment made for General Reserve due to change in profit-sharing ratio)

questions.text:
रॉकी तथा विक्की एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा 4:3 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटते थे । 1 अप्रैल, 2024 को शिवाय को लाभों में 2/7 भाग के लिए एक नया साझेदार बनाया गया। जिसे उसने रॉकी तथा विक्की से बराबर-बराबर प्राप्त किया। शिवाय के प्रवेश की तिथि को रॉकी तथा विक्की का स्थिति विवरण ₹ 7,00,000 का कामगार क्षतिपूर्ति संचय दर्शा रहा था । शिवाय के प्रवेश की तिथि पर निम्न प्रत्येक स्थिति में कामगार क्षतिपूर्ति संचय के लेखांकन की आवश्यक रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए :
(i) कामगार क्षतिपूर्ति के दावे की राशि ₹ 5,60,000 थी ।
(ii) कामगार क्षतिपूर्ति के दावे की राशि ₹ 7,00,000 थी ।
(iii) कामगार क्षतिपूर्ति के दावे की राशि ₹ 7,20,000 थी ।
questions.text_english:
Rocky and Vicky were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 4:3. On 1st April, 2024 Shivay was admitted as a new partner for 2/7th share in profits which he acquired equally from Rocky and Vicky. On the date of Shivay's admission, the Balance Sheet of Rocky and Vicky showed Workmen Compensation Reserve of ₹ 7,00,000. Pass necessary journal entries for treatment of workmen compensation reserve on the date of Shivay's admission in each of the following cases:
(i) Claim on account of workmen compensation amounted to ₹ 5,60,000.
(ii) Claim on account of workmen compensation amounted to ₹ 7,00,000.
(iii) Claim on account of workmen compensation amounted to ₹ 7,20,000.

key_points: Case (i) WCR (7,00,000) is utilized for claim (5,60,000). Excess (1,40,000) distributed to Rocky (80,000) and Vicky (60,000) in 4:3.
Case (ii) WCR (7,00,000) is fully utilized for claim (7,00,000). No distribution.
Case (iii) WCR (7,00,000) falls short of claim (7,20,000). Debit Revaluation A/c by 20,000. Entry 1: WCR Dr 7,00,000, Revaluation A/c Dr 20,000 To Prov for WC 7,20,000.

sub_questions.text: 1 अक्टूबर, 2023 को आकाश तथा बादल ने क्रमशः ₹ 80,00,000 तथा ₹ 60,00,000 की पूँजी के साथ साझेदारी में प्रवेश किया। उन्होंने लाभ एवं हानि को बराबर-बराबर बाँटने का निर्णय किया । साझेदारी संलेख के प्रावधानों के अनुसार साझेदारों को पूँजी पर 10% वार्षिक ब्याज का हक था। बादल को यह गारंटी दी गयी कि पूँजी पर ब्याज लगाने के पश्चात् लाभ में उसका भाग प्रतिवर्ष ₹ 7,00,000 से कम नहीं होगा । इस कारण हुई किसी भी कमी का वहन आकाश करेगा। 31 मार्च, 2024 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष के लिए फर्म का लाभ ₹ 13,00,000 था । 31 मार्च, 2024 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष के लिए फर्म का लाभ-हानि विनियोजन खाता तैयार कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Aakash and Baadal entered into partnership on 1st October, 2023 with the capitals of ₹ 80,00,000 and ₹ 60,00,000 respectively. They decided to share profits and losses equally. Partners were entitled to interest on capital @ 10% per annum as per the provisions of the partnership deed. Baadal is given a guarantee that his share of profit, after charging interest on capital will not be less than ₹ 7,00,000 per annum. Any deficiency arising on that account shall be met by Aakash. The profit of the firm for the year ended 31st March, 2024 amounted to ₹ 13,00,000. Prepare Profit and Loss Appropriation Account for the year ended 31st March, 2024.

key_points: Calculate Interest on Capital for 6 months (Oct to Mar). Aakash = ₹ 4,00,000. Baadal = ₹ 3,00,000.
Calculate divisible profit: ₹ 13,00,000 - ₹ 7,00,000 = ₹ 6,00,000.
Initial distribution in equal ratio: ₹ 3,00,000 each.
Calculate Baadal's guaranteed profit for 6 months: ₹ 7,00,000 / 2 = ₹ 3,50,000.
Adjust deficiency: Deduct ₹ 50,000 from Aakash's share, add to Baadal's share.

sub_questions.solution:
Working Notes:
The business commenced on 1st October 2023, meaning the period up to 31st March 2024 spans exactly 6 months. 
Interest on Capital is calculated for 6 months at 10% p.a.:
Aakash's Interest = ₹ 80,00,000 × 10% × 6/12 = ₹ 4,00,000.
Baadal's Interest = ₹ 60,00,000 × 10% × 6/12 = ₹ 3,00,000.
Total Interest on Capital = ₹ 7,00,000.

Divisible Profit = Net Profit (₹ 13,00,000) - Total Interest on Capital (₹ 7,00,000) = ₹ 6,00,000.
Profit is shared equally, so Aakash and Baadal each receive ₹ 3,00,000.

Baadal's guaranteed minimum profit is ₹ 7,00,000 per annum. For 6 months, the guaranteed amount is proportionately reduced to ₹ 3,50,000. 
The shortfall in Baadal's share = ₹ 3,50,000 - ₹ 3,00,000 = ₹ 50,000.
This deficiency is to be borne by Aakash. 
Final Profit Share: Aakash = ₹ 3,00,000 - ₹ 50,000 = ₹ 2,50,000. Baadal = ₹ 3,00,000 + ₹ 50,000 = ₹ 3,50,000.

Profit and Loss Appropriation Account for the year ended 31st March, 2024:
Dr. Side:
To Interest on Capital: 
  Aakash: ₹ 4,00,000 
  Baadal: ₹ 3,00,000 (Total ₹ 7,00,000)
To Profit transferred to Partners' Capital A/cs:
  Aakash: 3,00,000 - 50,000 (deficiency) = ₹ 2,50,000
  Baadal: 3,00,000 + 50,000 (deficiency) = ₹ 3,50,000
Total Dr = ₹ 13,00,000

Cr. Side:
By Net Profit = ₹ 13,00,000
Total Cr = ₹ 13,00,000

sub_questions.text: पारूल तथा राजुल एक फर्म की साझेदार थीं तथा 5:3 के अनुपात में लाभ एवं हानि बाँटती थीं । 1 अप्रैल, 2023 को उनके स्थायी पूँजी खातों के शेष: पारूल ₹ 6,00,000 तथा राजुल ₹ 8,00,000 थे । साझेदारी संलेख में पूँजी पर 12% वार्षिक दर से ब्याज का प्रावधान था । 31 मार्च, 2024 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष के लिए फर्म का शुद्ध लाभ ₹ 1,26,000 था । 31 मार्च, 2024 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष के लिए लाभ-हानि विनियोजन खाता तैयार कीजिए। अपना कार्य स्पष्टता से दर्शाइए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Parul and Rajul were partners in a firm, sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 5: 3. The balance in their fixed capital accounts on 1st April, 2023 were Parul ₹ 6,00,000 and Rajul ₹ 8,00,000. The partnership deed provided for allowing interest on capital at 12% per annum. The net profit of the firm for the year ended 31st March, 2024 was ₹ 1,26,000. Prepare Profit and Loss Appropriation Account for the year ended 31st March, 2024. Show your working clearly.

key_points: Calculate required Interest on Capital. Parul = ₹ 72,000. Rajul = ₹ 96,000. Total required = ₹ 1,68,000.
Compare available profit (₹ 1,26,000) with total required appropriations (₹ 1,68,000). Since profit is insufficient, it must be distributed in the ratio of claims.
Calculate claim ratio based on Interest on Capital: 72,000 : 96,000, which simplifies to 3:4.
Distribute available profit in 3:4 ratio. Parul gets ₹ 54,000 and Rajul gets ₹ 72,000.
Prepare P&L Appropriation Account transferring these amounts as Interest on Capital to Current Accounts.

sub_questions.solution:
Working Notes:
First, we calculate the interest on capital as per the deed provisions.
Parul's Interest = ₹ 6,00,000 × 12% = ₹ 72,000.
Rajul's Interest = ₹ 8,00,000 × 12% = ₹ 96,000.
Total Interest required = ₹ 72,000 + ₹ 96,000 = ₹ 1,68,000.

The available net profit for the year is only ₹ 1,26,000, which is insufficient to cover the full interest on capital. In such cases where appropriations exceed available profit, the profit is distributed among partners in the ratio of their respective claims (i.e., the ratio of their interest on capital). 
The ratio of claims = 72,000 : 96,000 = 3:4.

Now, distribute the available profit of ₹ 1,26,000 in the 3:4 ratio:
Parul's share of Interest on Capital = ₹ 1,26,000 × 3/7 = ₹ 54,000.
Rajul's share of Interest on Capital = ₹ 1,26,000 × 4/7 = ₹ 72,000.

Profit and Loss Appropriation Account for the year ended 31st March, 2024:
Dr. Side:
To Interest on Capital (transferred to Current A/cs since capitals are fixed):
  Parul's Current A/c: ₹ 54,000
  Rajul's Current A/c: ₹ 72,000
Total Dr = ₹ 1,26,000

Cr. Side:
By Profit & Loss A/c (Net Profit) = ₹ 1,26,000
Total Cr = ₹ 1,26,000

sub_questions.text_english: Apoorv Ltd. acquired building worth ₹ 15,50,000, Machinery worth ₹ 11,40,000 and Furniture worth ₹ 1,10,000 from Dhruv Ltd. and took over its liabilities of ₹ 2,00,000 for a purchase consideration of ₹ 25,00,000. Apoorv Ltd. paid the purchase consideration by issuing 12% debentures of ₹ 100 each at a premium of 25%. Pass the necessary journal entries in the books of Apoorv Ltd. for the above transactions.

key_points: Compare net assets with purchase consideration (25,00,000) to find Capital Reserve of ₹ 1,00,000.
Journal entry for acquisition with credit to Capital Reserve.
Calculate number of debentures issued: 25,00,000 / 125 = 20,000 debentures.
Journal entry for issuing debentures to the vendor at a premium.

sub_questions.solution:
In the books of Apoorv Ltd., we first record the acquisition of the business. The total value of assets acquired is ₹ 15,50,000 + ₹ 11,40,000 + ₹ 1,10,000 = ₹ 28,00,000. Less liabilities of ₹ 2,00,000, the net assets acquired are ₹ 26,00,000. Since the agreed purchase consideration is ₹ 25,00,000, the company makes a capital profit of ₹ 1,00,000, which is credited to the Capital Reserve Account. 

The payment is made by issuing 12% debentures at a 25% premium. The issue price per debenture is ₹ 100 + ₹ 25 = ₹ 125. The number of debentures to be issued = ₹ 25,00,000 / ₹ 125 = 20,000 debentures.

questions.text_english:
Sargam Limited issued 2,000, 9% debentures of ₹ 500 each at a premium of 10%. The amount was payable as follows:

On Allotment - Balance (including premium)
The debentures were fully subscribed and all amounts were duly received. Pass the necessary journal entries for issue of debentures in the books of Sargam Limited.

key_points: Calculation of Premium: 10% of ₹ 500 = ₹ 50.

Simar, Tanvi and Umara were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 5:6:9. On 31st March, 2024 their Balance Sheet was as follows:

Umara died on 30th June, 2024. The partnership deed provided for the following on the death of a partner:
(i) Goodwill of the firm be valued at 3 years purchase of average profits for the last 5 years. The profit/loss for the previous four years were :
2022-23:₹3,10,000 (loss)
2021-22:₹3,00,000 (profit)
2020-21:₹4,00,000 (profit)
2019-20:₹2,50,000 (profit)
(ii) Umara's share of profit or loss till the date of her death was to be calculated on the basis of profit or loss for the year ended 31st March 2024.
(a) Calculate Goodwill of the firm.
(b) Pass the necessary journal entry for the treatment of goodwill on Umara's death.

sub_questions.solution:
To calculate the goodwill of the firm, we need the profits/losses of the last 5 years. Four years are given in the problem. The 5th year (2023-24) is found on the asset side of the Balance Sheet as 'Profit and Loss Account', which indicates a loss of ₹ 2,00,000.
Total Profit for 5 years = (Loss for 22-23) + (Profit for 21-22) + (Profit for 20-21) + (Profit for 19-20) + (Loss for 23-24)
Total Profit = (- ₹ 3,10,000) + ₹ 3,00,000 + ₹ 4,00,000 + ₹ 2,50,000 + (- ₹ 2,00,000) = ₹ 4,40,000.

Alexia Limited invited applications for issuing 1,00,000 equity shares of ₹ 10 each at premium of ₹ 10 per share. The amount was payable as follows:
On application ₹ 9 per share (Including premium ₹ 6 per share)
On allotment ₹ 8 per share (Including premium ₹ 4 per share)
On first and final call ₹ 3 per share.
Applications were received for 1,50,000 equity shares and allotment was made to the applicants as follows:
Category A: Applicants for 90,000 shares were allotted 70,000 shares.
Category B: Applicants for 60,000 shares were allotted 30,000 shares.
Excess money received on application was adjusted towards allotment and first and final call.

Pass necessary journal entries for the above transactions in the books of Alexia Limited. Open calls in arrears and calls in advance account, wherever necessary.

key_points: Receipt on application for 1,50,000 shares at ₹ 9 = ₹ 13,50,000.
Allotment of 1,00,000 shares. Transfer ₹ 3,00,000 to Share Capital and ₹ 6,00,000 to Securities Premium.

Adjustment of excess application money (₹ 4,50,000). Category A excess: 20k × 9 = 1,80,000. Allotment due for A: 70k × 8 = 5,60,000. So 1,80,000 fully adjusted to allotment. Category B excess: 30k × 9 = 2,70,000. Allotment due for B: 30k × 8 = 2,40,000. Adjusted to allotment = 2,40,000. Remaining 30,000 adjusted to Calls in Advance.
Total adjustment: Share Allotment ₹ 4,20,000; Calls in Advance ₹ 30,000.
Allotment money due on 1,00,000 shares at ₹ 8 = ₹ 8,00,000 (₹ 4L Cap, ₹ 4L SPR).
First & Final Call due on 1,00,000 shares at ₹ 3 = ₹ 3,00,000.
Shekhar (Cat B) applied for 1200, allotted 600. His call due = 600 × 3 = 1800. His Calls in Advance (from application) = 600 shares × ₹ 1 (excess after allotment) = 600. Arrears = 1800 - 600 = 1200.
First & Final Call received = 3,00,000 - 30,000 (Advance) - 1,200 (Arrears) = ₹ 2,68,800.

sub_questions.solution:
Working Notes:
Issue size = 1,00,000 shares. Face Value = ₹ 10, Premium = ₹ 10. Total = ₹ 20.
App: ₹ 9 (Cap ₹ 3, SPR ₹ 6)
Allot: ₹ 8 (Cap ₹ 4, SPR ₹ 4)
Call: ₹ 3 (Cap ₹ 3)

Category A (90k applied, 70k allotted): Excess shares = 20k. Excess money = 20,000 × ₹ 9 = ₹ 1,80,000. Allotment due on 70k shares = 70,000 × ₹ 8 = ₹ 5,60,000. Entire excess adjusted to Allotment.

Category B (60k applied, 30k allotted): Excess shares = 30k. Excess money = 30,000 × ₹ 9 = ₹ 2,70,000. Allotment due on 30k shares = 30,000 × ₹ 8 = ₹ 2,40,000. The remaining ₹ 30,000 is transferred to Calls in Advance for the final call.

Total excess transferred to Allotment = 1,80,000 + 2,40,000 = ₹ 4,20,000.
Total excess transferred to Calls in Advance = ₹ 30,000.

Shekhar applied for 1,200 shares (Cat B). Allotted shares = 1,200 × (30,000/60,000) = 600 shares.
Shekhar's total advance transferred to Call = 600 shares × (30,000/30,000 shares) = ₹ 600.
Shekhar's Call due = 600 × ₹ 3 = ₹ 1,800.
Shekhar's Calls in Arrears = 1,800 - 600 = ₹ 1,200.

questions.text: एक कम्पनी का तरल अनुपात 1: 1 है। निम्न में से कौन से लेनदेन का परिणाम तरल अनुपात की वृद्धि होगी ?
questions.text_english: The Quick Ratio of a company is 1: 1. Which of the following transactions will result in increase in Quick Ratio?
questions.solution:
Quick Ratio is the ratio of Quick Assets to Current Liabilities. Quick Assets include Cash, Debtors, etc., but exclude Inventory (Stock).
- (A) Cash received from debtors: Both cash and debtors are quick assets. Total quick assets remain unchanged. No effect.
- (B) Sold goods on credit: Debtors (quick asset) increase, while Stock (not a quick asset) decreases. Total quick assets increase while current liabilities remain unchanged. The Quick Ratio will increase.
- (C) Purchased goods on credit: Creditors (current liabilities) increase, Stock (not a quick asset) increases. The denominator increases while the numerator remains unchanged. The Quick Ratio will decrease.
- (D) Purchased goods on cash: Cash (quick asset) decreases, Stock (not a quick asset) increases. The numerator decreases while the denominator remains unchanged. The Quick Ratio will decrease.
Therefore, the correct option is (B).

Calculate Average Trade Receivables: Credit Revenue / TR Turnover Ratio = 6,00,000 / 4 = ₹ 1,50,000.

key_points: The ROUND function rounds a given number to a specified number of digits.
Syntax: =ROUND(number, num_digits)
'number' is the value you want to round.
'num_digits' specifies the number of digits to which you want to round the number.

sub_questions.solution:
The 'ROUND' function in Excel is a mathematical function used to round a specific numerical value to a predetermined number of digits. It follows standard rounding rules: if the digit following the rounding point is 5 or greater, it rounds up; if it is less than 5, it rounds down.

The syntax for the function is: `=ROUND(number, num_digits)`

- 'number': This is the actual numeric value or the cell reference containing the number you want to round.
- 'num_digits': This argument specifies the exact number of digits to which you want the number rounded.
  - If 'num_digits' is greater than 0, the number is rounded to that many decimal places (e.g., `=ROUND(3.14159, 2)` results in 3.14).
  - If 'num_digits' is exactly 0, the number is rounded to the nearest whole integer (e.g., `=ROUND(3.6, 0)` results in 4).
  - If 'num_digits' is less than 0, the number is rounded to the left of the decimal point (e.g., `=ROUND(1234, -2)` results in 1200).

3. Navigate to the Insert Tab: Go to the 'Insert' tab located on the main Excel ribbon at the top of the screen.
4. Choose the Chart Type: In the 'Charts' group, locate and click the 'Insert Pie or Doughnut Chart' icon (it looks like a small pie).
5. Select the Format: A drop-down menu will appear showing various pie chart styles (such as 2-D Pie, 3-D Pie, or Doughnut). Click on the specific style you prefer.
6. Customize the Chart: Once the chart appears on the worksheet, click on it to activate the 'Chart Tools' context menus (Design and Format). Use these tools to add data labels, modify the chart title, and adjust the colors and styles to suit your presentation needs.
